pages.text: $(l)Garbage truck:$() back its hopper up to $(item)Trash Can$()s and press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) to empty them.$(br2)$(l)Dump truck:$() load its bed (sneak + right-click), then $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) tips it out.$(br2)$(l)Cement mixer:$() its drum sets concrete powder into concrete while the engine runs; $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) pours it.
$(l)Ice cream truck:$() a shop on wheels. Stock its freezer (sneak + right-click), price each kind at the serving hatch, and everyone else buys from it by card or cash. Its horn plays a jingle.
